judgment_text:
ORDER

The contempt petition has been filed praying to punish the Respondents for their act of committing Contempt of Court by disobeying the order of this Court dated 25-9-2023 in W.P. No. 27948 of 2023.

2. It is informed that the order of this Court has been complied with. Therefore, the contempt petition stands closed. No costs.
